decoder.interpretation: The installed getter returns GiB/s despite the API documentation's GB/s label. Equivalence to the separate cumulative counter is assessed experimentally, not assumed.

limitations: Outer bounds test consistency, not exact counter equivalence or calibration of the true byte/flit unit.
Getter profiling interval is assumed to lie inside its recorded API call bracket.
Interleaved per-card getter calls leave sampling gaps; no full-window byte total is inferred.
No mismatched/zero sample was discarded from the records.
